Karakteristikat e prones:
– Apartament 1+1
– Zona Ali Demi
– Pallati ekzistues
– Kati 1
– Siperfaqja bruto 57m²
– Cmimi 137,000 Euro
Shitet apartament 1+1 me siperfaqe 57 m², i cili ndodhet ne katin e 1 te nje pallati ekzistues,ne Ali Dem, prane shkolles 1 Maji. Apartamenti organizohet nga korridori shperndares, nje dhome gjume, salloni dhe ambjenti i ndenjes, tualeti, depo dhe ballkoni i cili eshte i ndare me vetrat xhami. Eshte totalisht i investuar dhe restauruar, i shtruar me parket, instalime hidraulike dhe elektrike te reja, dritare dopio-xham, hidrosanitare te reja etj.
Nje mundesi shume e mire per investim edhe si ambient biznesi!!
Ndodhet ne nje zonë të qetë e cila i ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme.
Per me shume informacione ose per nje vizite ne prone kontaktoni ne numrin e agjencise imobiliare.

description_en: Property characteristics: - 1+1 apartment - Ali Demi area - Existing building - 1st floor - Gross area 57m² - Price 137,000 Euros 1+1 apartment with an area of ​​57 m² for sale, located on the 1st floor of an existing building, in Ali Dem, near the 1 Maji school. The apartment is organized by a distribution corridor, a bedroom, a living room and a living room, a toilet, a storage room and a balcony which is separated by glass windows. It is totally invested and restored, laid with parquet, new plumbing and electrical installations, double-glazed windows, new plumbing, etc. A very good opportunity for investment as a business environment!! It is located in a quiet area that offers all the necessary facilities. For more information or for a visit to the property, contact the number of the real estate agency.
